mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 65 degrees under overcast skies near Fireman's Park, with a full moon rising tonight.

The City of Verona continues its partnership with AECOM for ongoing engineering services, while the Department of Transportation is seeking community feedback on the US 18/151 Corridor project through public meetings on November 18 and 19.

We have a busy schedule ahead with trivia at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee today, plus more trivia and live music at Paddy Mac's tomorrow, and don't forget the annual Main Street Trick or Treat coming up on October 29.
Regarding recent activity, on October 25, officers arrested a man for an O W I offence after finding him in his vehicle at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Enjoy the delicious Chocolate Caramel Twist today at the local Culver's, which is currently open and serving until 10 PM tonight.
